about_the_game:
The Glory of Hellforn

The dungeons of Hellforn, the goddess of art and madness, have undergone a second revival. In her treasury, her followers have found the blueprints to restore the dungeons' artistic architecture, and the once drab dungeons have been transformed into something truly spectacular. Decorate your dungeon with golden columns, red roofs, and beautiful statues and decorations!

This DLC transforms the exterior of the dungeon in the game.
